summary: LIVE end-to-end verification of partner selfie camera (web_panel CameraCapture with faceGuide) against preview URL. Logged in as demo partner (Raj Kumar / +919000000003), opened Active Jobs, selected booking AZOB98D25 (AC Gas Refill, assigned), advanced JobWizard: Details -> Check-in, clicked wizard-selfie-btn to open CameraCapture. Stubbed navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia with a canvas.captureStream whose frames are swapped between (a) a real human face image loaded same-origin via /__test_face.jpg (served from web_panel/public), (b) a plain two-tone 'landscape' frame, (c) a near-black frame. MediaPipe FaceDetector (@mediapipe/tasks-vision 1.0.1) actually loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net + storage.googleapis.com and ran against the canvas-sourced <video>. All 4 required behaviours plus countdown + confirm flow + CDN-blocked fallback verified. Expo SelfieCamera.tsx reviewed statically; `tsc --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0` in /app/frontend reports no errors in SelfieCamera.tsx.

static_only_verified: frontend/src/components/partner/SelfieCamera.tsx (Expo): lazy require('@infinitered/react-native-mlkit-face-detection') with cached detectorInit promise; probe loop every ~900ms calls takePictureAsync({quality:0.15, exif:true, shutterSound:false, skipProcessing:false}); isDark() uses iOS BrightnessValue (<-0.5) or EV100 from ExposureTime/FNumber/ISOSpeedRatings; faceInOval uses MAX scaling (cover) consistent with CameraView preview; probing/shooting mutex (shoot() awaits while probing.current); 3-fail fallback sets {faceOk:true, unavailable:true}; countdown via setCount(3) + setTimeout chain. tsc --noEmit --ignoreDeprecations 6.0 in /app/frontend reports NO errors in SelfieCamera.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: CameraCapture.jsx FaceGuide fallback (unavailable=true): color stays white (`st.faceOk && !st.unavailable ? '#22C55E' : '#FFFFFF'`) so oval remains white-dashed even though shutter is active & green. Functionally correct (capture not blocked) but visually mildly inconsistent. Low priority.

CameraCapture.jsx FaceGuide useEffect [] deps -- `videoRef` and `onStatus` are referenced inside but omitted (comment eslint-disable). OK since videoRef is stable and onStatus is captured via setFace in parent; no action needed.
SelfieCamera.tsx shoot() uses a busy-wait loop (while probing.current) with 80ms sleep. Fine in practice; could add a maxWait to avoid rare deadlock if a probe hangs. Low priority.

SelfieCamera.tsx silent probe uses full takePictureAsync with shutterSound:false - on some Android (Xiaomi/Samsung/Vivo) OEMs the system shutter sound may still play (hardware policy). Needs physical-device confirmation (out of scope here).

web CameraCapture snap() in selfie mode: `canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(v,0,0)` captures raw video (not mirrored). Front camera is NOT CSS-mirrored in the <video>, so the stored selfie is the raw camera orientation. Acceptable but worth confirming with product spec.
